about.hero_subtitle: A passion for chocolate, a love for people.
about.story_p1: Sweets by Talya was born from a deep love of chocolate and the joy of making people smile. Talya started crafting chocolates in her home kitchen, experimenting with flavors and techniques until every piece was perfect.
about.story_p2: What began as a hobby quickly became a calling. Today, every praline, brownie, and chocolate box is still made by hand — with the same love and dedication as the very first batch.
about.value1_desc: No machines, no shortcuts. Every piece is made by hand.
about.value2_desc: Premium Belgian chocolate and the freshest local ingredients.
about.value3_desc: We pour our heart into every creation.
about.value4_desc: Every order is unique, just like the person receiving it.
about.process_step1_desc: Premium Belgian chocolate and fresh local ingredients
about.process_step2_desc: Every piece handmade with care and precision
about.process_step3_desc: Fresh to your door, beautifully packaged

workshops.page_subtitle: Unique handcrafted chocolate experiences for every occasion.
workshops.w1_subtitle: Dive into a world of creativity, flavours and fun in a unique chocolate workshop designed especially for girls aged 10–13.
workshops.occasion_batmitzvah: Bat Mitzvah celebrations — a creative and unique event
workshops.occasion_birthday: Birthday parties — a bonding experience with all your friends
workshops.occasion_other: Any joyful occasion that calls for creativity and togetherness
workshops.activities_title: 👩‍🍳 What awaits us in the workshop?
workshops.activity1_desc: Create a large, beautifully designed chocolate heart filled with sweet surprises and treats.
workshops.activity2_desc: Fill premium chocolate shells, choose from 3 favourite flavours, and seal them professionally.
workshops.activity3_desc: Add your name, age, and use colourful chocolate, decorative accessories and special ornaments.
workshops.activity4_desc: Decorate a personal box filled with marshmallows and extra treats.
workshops.activity5_desc: Write personal blessing notes to the birthday girl — creating shared memories together.
workshops.activities_closing: At the end of the workshop: each participant takes home her creations in a decorated box with a ribbon, plus a 'Young Chocolatier' certificate! 🎓
workshops.pricing_note: * Price includes all materials, facilitation, decorations and the box each participant takes home.
workshops.why_text: In our workshop, the girls don't just make chocolates — they experience something special together 💖. Each one creates her own chocolate heart, fills pralines, designs and decorates, and at the end there's a touching moment between friends.
workshops.cta_subtitle: Contact us and we'll arrange the perfect workshop for your group.
workshops.hero_subtitle: Learn the art of handcrafted chocolate.
workshops.w2_subtitle: Dive into a world of creativity, flavours and fun in a unique chocolate workshop designed especially for teens and young women aged 14+.
workshops.w2_occasion_teambuilding: Team building day — a bonding experience with friends
workshops.w2_activity1_desc: Create a large, beautifully designed chocolate heart filled with sweet surprises and treats.
workshops.w2_activity2_desc: Fill premium chocolate shells, choose from 3 favourite flavours, and seal them professionally to a high standard.
workshops.w3_subtitle: Everyday life doesn't always leave room for real quality time — but it's the simple moments together that become lifelong memories. Put down your phones and enter a world of creativity, laughter and connection, in the most comfortable place for you: your home.
workshops.w3_activity1_desc: Together you'll prepare the shell for an impressive egg (150g). You'll learn to work with chocolate and achieve a beautiful, professional result.
workshops.w3_activity2_desc: Each pair creates 2 personalised chocolate lollipops with toppings and decorations of their choice.
workshops.w3_activity3_desc: The parent writes a personal message to the child. The note goes inside the egg and is revealed only when it's broken open.
workshops.w3_activity4_desc: We'll fill the inside of the egg with colourful sweets and treats.
workshops.w3_activity5_desc: Simple decorating techniques to create a luxurious look that everyone can achieve.
workshops.w3_req1: Fridge with at least one free shelf
workshops.w3_req3: Tables and chairs suitable for children to sit comfortably and do the activity
workshops.w3_req4: Air-conditioned or temperature-controlled space to prevent the chocolate from melting
